title: Zero-section divisor class, its etale realization, and compact source
statement:
Fix the finite-coefficient datum of [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_F$ and uniformizer $\varpi_F$, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^n$. Let $B$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme and $\pi:E\to B$ a vector bundle of rank one with zero section $z:B\to E$ [def-pur-vector-bundle-zero-section]. Use the prescribed pro-etale twist $A_T(1)$ [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Then $\pi$ is separated of finite type and smooth of relative dimension one, and $D=z(B)$ is an effective Cartier divisor, smooth over $B$ of relative codimension one, which remains Cartier after every base change $B'\to B$ of the bundle and its zero section.

Let $c^{p}_{D,A}:z_*A_B\to A_E(1)[2]$ be the supported Cartier Kummer morphism of [lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map]. Under the supported-class realization of [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer], the relative Kummer class $\operatorname{cl}(D)$ of [lem-pur-divisor-class] is exactly $c^{p}_{D,A}$. Its local supported class in a bundle coordinate $t$ is $-\partial\kappa(t)$, with $\kappa$ and the support boundary in the conventions of [def-pur-frame-class] and [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary].

Put $N=\ell^n$, which kills $A$, and $L_T=\mu^{\mathrm{et}}_{N,T}\otimes^L_{\mathbf Z/N}A_T$, where $\mu^{\mathrm{et}}_{N,T}$ is the sheaf of $N$th roots of unity. Let $c^e_{D,A}:z_*A_B\to L_E[2]$ be the ordinary etale supported Kummer morphism of [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer]. With $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{et}}$ and comparison pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback], the projection-induced twist comparison $\nu_T^*L_T\cong A_T(1)$ carries $\nu_E^*c^e_{D,A}$ to $c^p_{D,A}$.

Under the canonical identity-normalized composition identification $R\pi_!z_*A_B\cong A_B$, the map $\tau_E=R\pi_!c^p_{D,A}$ is the realization of $R\pi_!^{\mathrm{et}}c^e_{D,A}$, with source $A_B$ and target $R\pi_!^{\mathrm{et}}L_E[2]$, through the comparison of [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison]. In particular the map itself, with these specified source and target identifications, has a bounded-below etale-origin witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. No invertibility of $\tau_E$ is asserted.

proof.text: Apply lem-pur-line-zero-geometry. Unpack its geometric conclusions and projective completion. The effective Cartier center characterization supplies invertibility and closedness for every base-changed section; sectionBaseChange is definitionally lineZeroBaseChange. The completion supplies HasCompactification, and the section identity supplies the identity compactification for the composite. Exact closed pro-etale direct image follows from the Noetherian complement via lem-exc-proetale-closed-exact. This proves line_zero_geometry.

source.place: Step 1, global Cartier zero divisor: affine frames, projective completion, smoothness, codimension and arbitrary base change; expanded realization proof steps 1--2

proof.text: Apply relativeCartierKummer_realization to the line zero Cartier divisor, obtaining SupportedKummerBoundary and equality of the general divisor and agreement Cartier maps. Apply divisor_class, and identify its uniquely normalized etale family with generalDivisorEtaleClasses to obtain DivisorLocalEquations.

proof.text: Apply cartierSupported_comparison_square to the zero section and unfold the degree-zero arrow and comparison wrappers. This is exactly the supported comparison conjunct.

proof.text: Specialize comparisonImage_closed_section_normalization to the zero section and the bundle projection, giving the compact-source normalization with exactly the named source isomorphisms of this module. Apply naturality of the compact-support site comparison to the etale Cartier map, then use the supported square. Cancel source isomorphisms to substitute the source-normalization equation; postcompose with the bounded-below compatibility inverse. This yields the displayed equality for the actual lineZeroTau and the fixed origin witnesses.
